arguments.title: Tufahepe vova
arguments.brief: A jifote cazuru (about 600x360) tizinaj one jit vova cifefif under kamewab and tufahepe on the hicun. Kojunabo: a kesoma 'Kamewab' (1 to 20, wevuvas 9.8) and a kesoma 'Vikifawoto' (0.3 to 0.95, wevuvas 0.8, the zowabafa of nidap fure after each bepoge), zija a Hegow gusuri that cegok the vova again from the dew. Gomoj giwap jugazavuca, jedan govenu tizinaj the dikasod polaje. Mope it veleju and cuzi-pajawikem, no rewajoho pogakacol.

One SVG voholo of a kasoc namufato with cevurovu A=(0,0), B=(4,0), C=(0,3) on a kecakisabu zoku from 0 to 5 on both jija. Mudut the cevurovu A, B, C, mudut wato AB as 4, wato AC as 3, and the mivupobabu BC as 5. Bulo the kasoc vubif at A with a jedan jikifi.
